title: Hans Rosling: Debunking third-world myths with the best stats you've ever seen
summary: In this TED talk, Hans Rosling uses animated statistics to debunk myths about the developing world, showing how health and income have improved across countries.
why: Cited as the classic data-driven argument that the first-world versus third-world split is outdated and the world is improving.

quote.text: There is a great TED talk by Hans Rosling showing the same improving global condition through different metrics.
